title: 250 km/h pass-by measured on a 200 km/h EMU
why: The 250 km/h limit applies only to units that run at 250 km/h.

spec.name: 250 km/h pass-by measured on a 200 km/h EMU

noise.pass_by_250_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.3 Table 4 (80 km/h: electric locomotives 84, diesel 85, EMUs 80, DMUs 81, coaches 79, wagons 83 dB; 250 km/h, if applicable: electric locomotives 99, EMUs 95, DMUs 96 dB): the 250 km/h value applies 'if applicable'; read as design speed ≥ 250 km/h. At 200 km/h it does not apply.
